summary: This clinical study tests a drug called HRS9531 compared to a placebo, which is an inactive treatment that looks like the real drug, in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body does not handle sugar well, leading to high blood sugar levels. The study is currently Recruiting and plans to enroll 300 participants. The sponsor of this trial is Fujian Shengdi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
